notes.content:
Puzzle changes
[list]
[*] Changed the (impossible spoiler) [spoiler]cryptic puzzle solution[/spoiler] which required many [spoiler]puzzle name changes[/spoiler].
[*] Added [spoiler]bonus[/spoiler] to Flare.Clear.
[*] Color changes on Mjolnir.Barrage.
[*] Moved Parallax and O in Trapped. Parallax [spoiler]bonus[/spoiler] was actually impossible in the old position!
[/list]

Misc
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with the puzzle editor where it would sometimes load the hub world instead of the selected puzzle.
[*] Added profile name to bottom left of main menu when more than one profiles exist.
[*] Added support for using (post-Inception) [spoiler]export spiral[/spoiler] from the hub puzzle. This is not in the game, so only relevant for puzzle editor.
[*] Using (post-Replication) [spoiler]fancy export spiral[/spoiler] will now zoom the player out of the current puzzle instead of giving the lame notification [spoiler]"Extraction from Replication is complete..."[/spoiler].
[*] Show the (post-Replication) [spoiler]fancy export spiral icon[/spoiler] instead of the (post-Inception) [spoiler]regular export spiral icon[/spoiler] on the puzzle label button and warp button label, when appropriate.
[*] Removed the "RemoveMyAchievements" Easter egg since it appears to be bugged with packaged builds. It still works correctly with non-packaged builds, but in my testing today with packaged builds it was doing the exact opposite: awarding all achievements instantly. Did anyone use this previously? Not sure if this is a new bug or not.
[/list]

Huge thanks to Mikan for discovering the Flare.Clear addition and finding several of these bugs today!

[list]
[*] Rearranged main menu buttons. Removed "Wishlist" and renamed "Feedback" to "Discord".
[*] Removed "Wishlist" and "Feedback" buttons from end-game end prompt.
[*] Replaced "Aspiring Speedrunner" achievement with a similar, but more involved "Sequence Breaker" achievement that does not need to be secret to avoid spoilers. It's quite clever, and uses the recent change I made to Impossible. Shoutout to Mikan for discovering it!
[*] (Post-Replication) [spoiler]Replication spiral thingy[/spoiler] now also flashes until used like some of the other [spoiler]spirals[/spoiler]. It also shows from the hub world.
[*] Fixed bug preventing many achievements from unlocking based on your save. 25 of the 32 achievements can be unlocked by loading a saved profile with the appropriate puzzle completion or journal entry unlocked.
[/list]

Puzzles
[list]
[*] Removed Moonwalk.Y. Moved Pact to its place and renamed Pact to Y.
[*] Moved Barrage (unrechable puzzle in Ground Rules) to Mjolnir (in Dribble's spot), and moved Dribble to Pact's old spot in Moonwalk.
[*] Reworked Walk.Barrier. This led to a change of the (post-Replication) [spoiler]bonus[/spoiler], which required a (very slight) rework of [spoiler]Transition.Priority[/spoiler]. The resulting change actually makes (post-Replication) [spoiler]bonuses in Transition much more open since now you can do some things with Priority to make more imports "work"[/spoiler].
[*] Vertically flipped Flare.Precision, which allowed for (post-Vault) [spoiler]the grey laser walls to be removed without fear of launching being revealed too early[/spoiler].
[*] Added a fog tile back to Walk. My changes in the last patch introduced a cheese.
[*] Swapped Rubber and Countdown in Liftoff. Also added bonus solution to Rubber.
[/list]
Other
[list]
[*] Added tracks for Jungle (Flare), Forest (Liftoff), and Mountain (Attraction) biomes.
[*] Build version now only shows in the main menu.
[*] Main menu and pause menu buttons now change color according to biome. Same for "Gentoo Rescue" logo. Also added text "by Jagriff" to main menu.
[*] Completed first draft of credits, which is now also accessible from the main menu. Please check that your name is correct!
[/list]

[list]
[*] Removed fog from Lemniscate.Momentum. It was just there to restrict the state space, but in this case it doesn't justify the fact that it also defocuses the puzzle.
[*] Removed Walk.Dodge.
[*] Rearranged some puzzles in Walk, and removed the bottom two fogs.
[*] Overriding biome in settings from the main menu will now correctly update the loaded level.
[*] Added music for Plains (Lemniscate) and Autumn (Walk) biomes. More music volume adjustments.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added music for the Ruins biome, which appears mainly in Inception.Foreboding. Next up will be all of the green biomes in Transition!
[*] Adjusted volume of all non-placeholder tracks to be a bit louder, and balanced them.
[/list]

Puzzle color swaps
[list]
[*] Replace green penguin by blue penguin in Moonwalk.Rebound because (post-Implant/Contraband) ||having a green penguin could spoil the import mechanic||.
[*] Replace blue penguins by yellow penguins in Impossible for a similar reason.
[*] Swap blue and red colors in Mjolnir.Stomp for a similar reason.
[/list]

Bind prompts
[list]
[*] Move, undo, reset, and selection bind prompts now animate (with rapid grow/shrink) until the bind is used. Once used, the prompt will not animate again unless the puzzle is reloaded. The warp bind prompts do not animate.
[*] Removed journal bind prompt from GroundRules.Landing.
[*] Moved undo bind prompt from GroundRules to GroundRules.Landing.
[/list]

Journal
[list]
[*] Increased size of journal button images and widened the buttons. 
[*] Locked "??" journal menu buttons no longer animate when selected, and they are aded.
[*] Decreased "New entry!" journal notification size, moved it to bottom right, and added journal/hint bind prompt to it.
[*] Journal "New entry!" notification now plays exactly when an entry is unlocked, instead of waiting until a new puzzle loads. The 3 entries that unlock on puzzle victory (one for each win critera) still wait until the next puzzle load.
  [list]
  [*] Now it is possible to receive multiple notifications in a single puzzle.
  [*] It also encourages checking the journal as soon as anything new happens, which I don't want to do.
  [*] But delaying the notification led to a lot of confusion about what was unlocking, when it was unlocking, and why. So I prefer this despite the issues.
  [/list]
[/list]

Other
[list]
[*] Relaxed case-sensitivity for Easter egg unlocks.
[*] The color permute function (which only supports swapping atm) in the puzzle editor will now automatically update hints.
[/list]

Bugfixes
[list]
[*] Redo bind now works as "menu back" from the main menu's setting menu.
[*] Movement bind prompt now shows on the very first puzzle GroundRules.Movement.
[*] Changing biome with override biome feature will now update the music. (Bugs when doing this from the main menu still remain, for now.)
[/list]

This update is long overdue, so it's a big one. I know most playtesters have played the game to death already, but since I'm releasing soon (May 22nd), I'll be especially grateful to anyone that can boot it up and play around for a little more before then.

Puzzles
[list]
[*]Removed Omega [spoiler]first puzzle with infinite bouncing[/spoiler] from being technically required in Moonwalk, since it is a difficult "lateral thinking" puzzle. This required rearranging several of the other post-Omega puzzles in Moonwalk. The mechanic is fundamental, but it's not so essential that it must block progress with Omega. It's something that is very likely to be (accidentally) discovered in Foreboding or Lemniscate if a player misses it in Moonwalk.
[*]Removed 2 destructible walls from Omega.
[*]Rearranged Stomp and Spin in Mjolnir. Now 1) Spin is much more likely to be encountered first and 2) Stomp is more clearly optional.
[*]Added new puzzle Volley in Pass that focuses on one technique of Pass.Trade.
[*]Simplified Pass.Trade. It now requires the use of [spoiler]"bouncing" an item[/spoiler].
[*]Reworked Pass.Handoff. It's smaller and with fewer states, but not easier. Also requires the use of [spoiler]"bouncing" an item[/spoiler].
[*]Added 2 (end-game) levels to Pass: Termination and Pinch.
[*]Swap locations of Ebb and Flow in Lemniscate.
[*]Removed unnecessary fogs from Mjolnir.Propagation.
[/list]

Music
[list]
[*]Complete overhaul. Before there were some layers for a few of the items (spring, hammer, magnet, cane, bomb, rocket) which played whenever the current puzzle has that item, allowing multiple layers to play at once. All of the layers except the spring were bad, with the hammer and bomb being especially terrible. Then there were 4 general tracks that played for puzzles without any items. These were okay, but they were all made before penguins were even in the game.
[*]One of the old general tracks is being used for the Ice biome.
[*]The Ice hub world is an exception here, with a special track that has multiple versions depending on the player's progress.
[*]Created new tracks for Beach and Desert.
[*]Created new (temporary) track for Hell. It's suitable for Impossible, which players will encounter very early. But it's not suitable for the Hell world (end of Accumulation spoiler) [spoiler]Vault[/spoiler] because it's just single pad instrument that will get old quickly.
[/list]

Puzzle names
[list]
[*]A lot of puzzles had weird initialism names. These were just random references, which would be a pretty lame discovery for anyone that gets excited about the possibility of a cryptic puzzle. They were just placeholder names at first, but then I had too much fun with it making "read my mind" type puzzle names.
[*]These puzzles have been renamed. Here are the old names with explanations:
[list]
[*] Old song (mostly pre-90s) references
[list]
[*] AIWWFHM -> Walk [spoiler]And I would walk five hundred more - This world is about walking.[/spoiler]
[*] YSMRRBRR -> Round [spoiler]You spin me right round baby right round - This puzzle involves some spins.[/spoiler]
[*] RM BOHFUHA -> CTA [spoiler]Rocket man, burning out his fuse up here alone - Rocket puzzle.[/spoiler]
[*] UCTT -> N [spoiler]You can't touch this - Hammer puzzle.[/spoiler]
[*] BJINML -> Y [spoiler]Billy Jean is not my lover - Puzzle in Moonwalk with a lot of backwards moves.[/spoiler]
[*] TOM TMO IBG -> SO [spoiler]Take on me, take me on, I'll be gone - Mask item is internally called TAKE.[/spoiler]
[/list]
[*]Movie references
[list]
[*] DYUTWTACOOMM -> Rush [spoiler]Do you understand the words that are coming out of my mouth? - Rush Hour reference because the puzzle is a Rush Hour puzzle.[/spoiler]
[*] WNTGD -> Deeper [spoiler]We need to go deeper - Inception reference because this puzzle has many layers of recursion.[/spoiler]
[*] IAT -> Trapped [spoiler]It's a trap - Star Wars meme because this world is about traps.[/spoiler]
[/list]
[*]Game references
[list]
[*] BHBP -> Planted [spoiler]Bomb has been planted - Counter-strike because this puzzle had an immovable animal holding a bomb.[/spoiler]
[*] NYTWP -> [spoiler]Thinking[/spoiler]. You can probably guess this one. It's the first puzzle in Lemniscate, which introduces teleporters. [spoiler]Now you're thinking with portals - Portal.[/spoiler]
[/list]
[*]Misc
[list]
[*] UDLR -> Movement [spoiler]Up down left right, because this is the first puzzle in the game and it's purpose is just to teach movement only.[/spoiler]
[/list]
[/list]
[*]In addition to this, I have actually added a cryptic puzzle based on puzzle names. One puzzle per world has a clue. This game is very much not a cryptic game, so it does not lead to anything useful or particularly interesting. The following puzzles were renamed as a result (not including the ones already listed above):
[list]
[*] Warehouse -> X
[*] Nest -> P
[*] Give and Take -> W
[*] Snagging -> V
[*] Betwixt -> IS
[*] Ebb -> E
[*] Handoff -> ON
[*] Stuck -> ETO
[*] Smuggle -> O
[*] Isolation -> I
[*] Pneumatic -> TE
[*] Pinned -> H
[*] Flicker -> D
[*] Double -> OWI
[*] Conduit -> L
[*] Southwest -> DN
[/list]
[/list]

Bugfixes
[list]
[*] Fixed some rare visual bugs that could occur when doing cursed things in the puzzle editor with [spoiler]flinging items to animals holding items[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed bug where it was possible to select tiles in the puzzle editor while the hint or permute menus were open.
[*] Fixed (visual, probably unnoticable) bug where the current state of the superlevel would not load properly on the initial load.
[*] Fixed (visual, probably unnoticable) bug where the current state of the super-superlevel would not load properly as the superlevel when exitting the current puzzle.
[*] Fixed bug where loading a backup would not reset the move list.
[/list]

Other
[list]
[*]Added some small animations to buttons in main menu, pause menu, end popup, journal, and elsewhere.
[*]Added close button prompt to settings menu. It works as a button for mouse users.
[*]Added acceleration on key repeat for movement (in menus only, no movement key repeat at all in-game) and undo/redo.
[*]Added a flash effect to unused color pin-wheel spiral thing when it appears in spots [spoiler]for which its use is required for progression[/spoiler].
[*]Added new sound effect for lock explosion. It still kinda sucks but it shouldn't be as annoying as before.
[*]Added another ridiculous Easter egg. This one is for playing zoomed out by a factor of 3. Try it out with [spoiler]GameForAnts[/spoiler]. Why? IDK. It did help me notice two bugs regarding superlevels.
[*]Removed achievement about the unreachable pin-wheel spiral thing that is encountered in Return. Too many achievements too early, and this one was kind of pointless.
[/list]

Work remaining before releasee
[olist]
[*]Music.
[*]Credits and bonus credits. Please reach out with what you want in the credits if you haven't already!
[*]Finish adding hints for all levels.
[/olist]

Work remaining after releasee
[olist]
[*]Support for playing custom level packs outside of the puzzle editor.
[*]Steam workshop support.
[*]Some puzzle editor polish.
[/olist]

Puzzle
[list]
[*] Small rework to Exchange.Diabolical to remove some distracting teleporters.
[*] Minor change to remove some unnecessary fog from IAT.Interlock.
[*] Swap Toss and Hurdle level positions in Crowdsurf.
[/list]

Other
[list]
[*] Items fall through traps much faster.
[*] Animation freezing (aka pausing) when menus are opened is back. This was removed in 0.6.0.
[*] If the player selects "Save and quit" while a move is animating, the moves will be undone until before the animating move upon returning to the main menu.
[/list]

Bugfixes
[list]
[*] Adding animation freezing back (see above) fixed a bug where it was possible to swap animals and move while in the warp menu.
[*] Fixed a bug where having old save state for a level could make a blank (post Inception spoiler) [spoiler]export[/spoiler] menu pop up when starting it. I doubt this happened to anyone but me.
[*] Fixed a bug where loading into a completed puzzle without any animals remaining (i.e., GroundRules.Escape) from the main menu would show the undo/reset impossible state screen.
[/list]

Puzzle
[list]
[*] Another minor change to Moonwalk.Reciprocity.
[*] Removed fog tile from Crowdsurf.Distribute. It took uniqueness too far at the tradeoff of removing some focus from the puzzle.
[*] Swapped Jackhammer and Drop locations in Foreboding.
[*] Moderate rework to Foreboding.Disguise. The new version has much less fog and gives the walrus the spring on start, which should make the puzzle more focused.
[*] Minor rework to Mjolnir.UCTT. Let the red penguin start with the hammer because the question "who needs hammer?" is not clear without some experimentation.
[/list]

Main menu redesign
[list]
[*] Your current level is shown from a skewed angle in the main menu.
[*] The camera will transition between the normal top-down angle and main menu angle when leaving/entering the main menu. Initial load has a special animation.
[*] Added animations to menu text for the transition to/from main menu.
[*] Added an Easter egg that allows one to play the game with an angle similar to the one in the main menu. [spoiler]Play this way with a player name containing "GoingDutch". Using "GoingDutchNeedsMorePixels" will let you combine both Easter eggs.[/spoiler]
[/list]

Related tweaks
[list]
[*] Corrected static penguin goal mesh used for sublevels, superlevels, and the previews in the puzzle editor. The old version didn't have the small goal penguins in the correct positions, and this was noticable from the new main menu.
[*] Corrected colored spiral (see Ground Rules.Return) height for sublevels, superlevels, and the previews in the puzzle editor. The old version had issues that were noticeable from the new main menu.
[*] Lowered the max scale of the smoke/fog sprites because it could be seen from too close in the new main menu, which looked bad.
[*] Removed stars from space biome background. The new pause menu killed the illusion.
[/list]

Other
[list]
[*] Added text "Warp to visited sublevels" at the top of the warp menu.
[*] Tweaked tile shaders to make the texture a bit rougher in the center of tiles, which will hopefully make it easier to count tiles. It's still quite subtle.
[*] "Water" rises on pause to replace the tint, which is still there for the warp menu.
[*] Replaced black background pause menu with plain text buttons that resemble those in the main menu. On the fence about this change since so much of the game uses the basic black menus already, and while I would like to improve them as well, I'm not sure how.
[*] Slightly lowered the top-down angle used for play. This might very slightly obscure some parts of buttons/traps on the top corners of big puzzles, if there are walls below them. I couldn't find any examples of these in existing puzzles, so this is mainly a custom level issue.
[*] Removed the animal distortion effect. It was either too subtle to be noticed or too extreme, which looked bad.
[*] Added click sounds to text buttons in main menu and pause menu.
[/list]

Puzzle
[list]
[*] Made Mjolnir.Spin more focussed by replacing the walrus with a penguin. Since this is one of the first hammer puzzles, the question of "Do I launch the walrus over the wall or just have it go into the water?" is not something that players will be able to answer without trial-and-error.
[*] Slight rework to Moonwalk.Reciprocity. This one actually became bigger, but with more fog to make a smaller state space. The important change was moving the green goal down so that the last 2-3 moves could be determined exactly. With the target in the middle, it required more insight to realize that the walrus had to be above the penguin.
[*] Removed from extra tiles from IAT.Invariant.
[*] Removed IAT.OBAT because it's really more of a rocket+magnet puzzle than a button/trap puzzle.
[*] Made Crowdsurf.Skid a bit smaller. The new version requires some slightly harder and more interesting moves, but it also has a smaller state space.
[/list]

Other
[list]
[*] Updated Easter egg unlock requirement. See notes from 0.5.30.
[/list]

Puzzle
[list]
[*] Simplified IAT.Parallax to make it smaller and make some deductions clearer.
[*] Minor rework to IAT.OBAT. Removed a gate because it had matching parity with the trap, so it didn't provide any value.
[*] Moderate rework to IAT.Toggle. It should better communicate who gets the spring. Also the right side is more interesting now.
[*] Removed IAT.Satisfy. This one looked super complex and intimidating, with so many buttons and gates. But players could sidestep all of this with a very easy brute-force because there were so few possible moves. Adding more moves and thus more logical steps wouldn't make the puzzle any more interesting, so better to just delete it.
[*] Moved Parity to Satisfy's location in IAT.
[/list]

Other
[list]
[*] Added an Easter egg. [spoiler]Make a new profile or rename your profile to "NotEnoughPixels". I actually like "NeedsMorePixels" better, so I will be changing this in the next build.[/spoiler] Ideas for other Easter eggs are welcome!
[/list]

Puzzle
[list]
[*] Small changes to Vault.Fuse.
[/list]

Bugfixes
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where attempting to close the pause popup while it is opening could pause the game without the pause popup being visible.
[*] Fixed bug where it was possible to Ctrl+Z exit from the pause menu while the end popup is visible.
[*] Fixed bug where it was possible in a cursed custom level to bug out the animation of a grey animal falling in a trap.
[/list]

Puzzles
[list]
[*] Moved Intercept in Liftoff because its old location was unreachable after other Liftoff changes (which were made a while ago :/).
[/list]

Other
[list]
[*] Darkened fog color in snow biome to make it contrast more.
[/list]

Bugfixes
[list]
[*] Fixed the "new puzzle" button not showing up in the sublevel select menu when there aren't any saved puzzles.
[*] Fixed penguin/item submenus in puzzle editor being disabled when a cracked or hole tile is selected. This blocked the ability to place fish on cracked/hole tiles and items on cracked tiles.
[/list]

Puzzle changes
[list]
[*] Moved Feed from Contraband to Replication. It was actually impossible to reach in its old location - sorry!
[/list]

Bugfixes
[list]
[*] Fixed bug in puzzle editor where a quick left click and release would sometimes leave more tiles selected than just the one that was clicked.
[*] Fixed bug where some [spoiler]exports[/spoiler] from Exfiltration were explicitly disallowed, but shouldn't have been. They were [spoiler]yellow penguin spring[/spoiler] and [spoiler]yellow penguin rocket[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed bug where starting a puzzle after using a mask could cause an item to visually stay on screen.
[*] Fixed bug where it was possible to use the warp menu to [spoiler]export[/spoiler] in the middle of a move.
[/list]

Other
[list]
[*] Update bind prompts in puzzle editor to change when it loads your binds, or when binds are changed.
[*] Added a way to remove achievements for those looking to test their unlock conditions or whatever. Make a profile named "RemoveMyAchievements" and then hit Play. Be aware that most achievements will unlock upon hitting Play with any (other) profile that has sufficient progress or journal entry unlocks, so you'll have to play with a fresh profile to avoid these auto-unlocks.
[/list]

Bugfixes
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed an animal to (visually) hold multiple items under a cursed puzzle editor scenario involving (Replication) [spoiler]simul movement[/spoiler], launching, and (not in game, but might add 1 puzzle for it?) [spoiler]infinite item loops[/spoiler].
[*] Cull extra items when recovering from a logic/visual desync event. This is a general fix to allow recovery if something similar to the above bug ever occurs again.
[/list]

Puzzle changes
[list]
[*] Reworked Exchange.Obstruction. I wanted a hole in the wall to bait an impossible set up, but this required some fog to de-cheese making the puzzle overall too noisy for what is supposed to teach an important use of the swap item. I also didn't like how the question "who gets the swap?" works in this puzzle. Players don't know the trick yet, so they'll just guess. If they guess incorrectly, there should be a way for experimentation to at least reveal the trick (in a way that doesn't solve the puzzle). The new version addresses both of these concerns.
[*] Reworked Exchange.Contact to be a bit smaller. The old version was too much of a "pruning" puzzle, while the new version brings a little more focus to the idea.
[*] Rearranged some puzzles in Exchange.
[/list]

Other
[list]
[*] Added rich text macros for grey arrows. Use them in the hints of the puzzle editor with P_LEFT, P_RIGHT, P_UP, and PDOWN. (grey used to be purple, which is why it's using P)
[*] Fixed bug where a puzzle could be reset from the pause menu while the end popup was visible.
[/list]

Puzzle editor: This isn't a focus pre-launch, but I'll try to tackle any quick bugfixes I can.
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where icons in edit mode would not show colors.
[*] Fixed bug where cancelling a teleporter placement would not destroy the visual effect.
[*] Fixed a lot of the conditions on when a button would be clickable. For example, if there is a block on a tile, then items should still be clickable (because item on block is allowed), but fog should not be clickable. So many of these were broken because I don't use these buttons at all.
[/list]

Puzlze editor has been enabled! It's usable without using my (personal, Colemak-based) hardcoded hotkeys, but it's rough.
[list]
[*] Click tiles. Multi select with CTRL.
[*] 12345 place animals. Shift 12345 for goals.
[*] qwfpb and shift+q/w/f/p/b for items.
[*] srct for walls/dwalls, shift+s/r/c/t for colored walls, shift+ctrl+s/r/c/t for gates
[*] ctrl+g = fish, ctrl+b = ctile/hole, ctrl+p = block, ctrl+f = fog, ctrl+w = button, ctrl+q = trap
[*] shift+ctrl+w = ascensions
[*] shift+alt+f = add teleporter...need to click again for destination
[*] shift+alt+s = add sublevel
[*] ctrl+z/x/c/v = undo/cut/copy/paste, ctrl+shift+z = redo, shift+alt+c = crop, del = delete
[*] ctrl+t = test, ctrl+s = save
[*] ctrl+shift+5 while testing to run solver from current position. Probably not super usable without logging (which you won't have).
[*] There are more hotkeys that I don't use so often. It's easy enough just to click the buttons for adding/removing rows/cols, rotating, or flipping the puzzle.
[/list]

Improving the custom levels experience will be a priority post-release, assuming people actually get excited enough about the game to start creating custom levels. Feel free to post levels (screenshot or actual files) in the Discord server. You can find the JSON files for a level in the install directory. I will make a dedicated channel for sharing levels if there's interest.

Other
[olist]
[*] Hide mouse buttons by default. They're only needed for mouse-only players, so not worth it to clog the UI for everyone by default since I expect mouse-only players to be quite rare.
[*] Hide color wheel when there is only one selectable color remaining, even if there are multiple animals of that color and levels to enter (thus meaning that the currently selected animal matters).
[*] Update wheel colors immediately upon export instead of waiting until the end of the animation.
[/olist]

Bugfixes
[list]
[*] Fixed race condition causing all input to be ignored if the player manages to pause on the same frame as completing a level.
[*] Fixed issue with bottom right gameplay settings in main menu settings menu being unclickable.
[/list]

Changes
[list]
[*] Removed splash screen.
[*] Automatically select ascending animal.
[*] Improved mask animation.
[/list]

Bugfixes
[list]
[*] Fixed animal icons on message popup. This could happen when there is a bind conflict with the direct selection binds.
[*] Fixed bug where export button would sometimes not display when starting a puzzle on an export spiral.
[*] Fixed bug where the warp spiral would rarely appear on locks to unseen puzzles.
[*] Fixed broken interaction between rocket and mask with [spoiler]simul movement[/spoiler].
[/list]

Puzzle changes
[list]
[*] Added bonuns solution for Exfiltration.Southwest. Thanks to Mikan for finding it!
[/list]

Other
[list]
[*] Allow left/right cycling within the same row of the (Implant/Contraband spoiler) [spoiler]import[/spoiler]/[spoiler]export[/spoiler] selection menu.
[*] Tweaked warp level movement again to prioritize any levels exactly on the input direction.
[*] Unified warp level movement algorithm with animal selection for consistency.
[*] Fixed rare visual bug where an animal falling through a cracked tile would waddle.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where removing the last bind for an action would not completely take effect right away.
[*] Fixed bug where CTRL+(WASD/arrow keys) would still perform moves. This fix means that you can bind the selection cluster to CTRL+WASD and then use WASD to move and CTRL+WASD to select. This won't be a default, but I expect some players will find this more convenient than using a separate cluster like IJKL.
[*] Tweaked the logic on warp menu level selection movement. It now sweeps across three arcs centered at the input direction: 90 degrees, 180 degrees, 360 degrees. If a level is found in a sweep, then the subsequent sweeps will not be checked. Within a single arc, the selection will go to the level that minimizes a weighted distance accounting for both the actual distance and the angular distance (from the input direction).
[/list]

Puzzle changes
[list]
[*] Fixed skip in Gentoo Rescue hub that allowed reaching Replication without even beating Transition. There is an intended skip (with an achievement) that's more involved, but this one was too OP and much more likely to happen on accident.
[*] Renamed Vault.Warp to Launch.
[*] Renamed Exfiltration.Cartography/Key to Warp/Source.
[*] Removed Exfiltration.Safehouse and put Warp in its place.
[*] Removed mask from Exfiltration.Southwest.
[*] Renamed Exchange.Transposition to Exchange.Stwap.
[*] Simplified Attraction.Fledging some more by replacing the yellow walrus with a grey penguin. Most of the difficulty is still there, but there are fewer options and more deducible goals.
[/list]

Other
[list]
[*] Unify teleporter colors between levels that are rendered as sublevels so that the zoom in / zoom out effect does not change teleporter colors.
[*] Fixed bug causing swap and mask to sometimes snap their rotation after being used.

Improved animal selection for gamepad/keyboard. Please give it a try and let me know your thoughts!
[list]
[*] "Direction select" is improved, and now the default method. This selects animals in a direction relative to the current selection, instead of by color. While not as optimal as the previous method, it's more intuitive and does not come with a big learning curve of having to remember which direction/key is which color. So this method makes sense to be the default.
[*] Animal selection used to be "hover on hold" and "select on release" of right stick / keyboard selction cluster. This was annoying because it's hard to have a controlled release of the right stick, so sometimes it would misinput.
[*] Keyboard selection cluster has a 40ms delay before selection. This gives a small window for two cardinal directions, like up and left, to combine into a northwest selection. Before this was only possible with frame perfect input. Having this soft limit of only 4 directions on keyboard was actually the main reason this was not the default before.
[*] Color wheel is now hidden by default. It is not really needed for this new default selection method, so cleaning up the UI is yet another advantage.
[*] New dedicated keyboard binds added for direction select. The in-game toggle now only applies to gamepad right-stick. Keyboard defaults for direction select are IJKL. Defaults for selection by color (old default) remain as 1234 for red/green/blue/yellow. It might make sense to add bind prompts for these to the color wheel (for those that enable it), since these defaults now no longer make sense directionally.
[*] Direction select is tuned to always select a new animal on input (unless you do something like left+right on keyboard). This means that it can work as a pseudo cycle bind for puzzles with only 2 animals, which is the overwhelming majority of puzzles. For this reason, I might remove the tutorialization of the cycle prev and cycle next binds, and instead move them to the "advanced binds" section. Let me know what you think of this.
[/list]
